purpose: A MONTE sweep draws the AGAUSS mismatch calls inside sky130's binned model cards per trial (#100).

oracle.derivation: ngspice 45 (nixpkgs), same circuit and models with mc_mm_switch=1, 1000 runs of reset + op: Id mean 1.0545 uA, stddev 0.2805 uA. i(vd) is -Id.
oracle.confirmed_reason: Monte Carlo moments of ngspice's own random draws: no second source draws the same samples.

notes: The generators differ, so only the statistics compare. Limits are about six combined standard errors of the two 1000-sample estimates. A nominal-only sweep has stddev 0 and fails.
